description: Start a new conversation from your connected account with one person, or a group of up to 50 (subject is the group's title). Answers the new thread_id for message_thread (null when it could not be read back; find it in messages_list). Optional attachment as on message_send. Costs $0.005 per action. Requires a connected account. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

attachment.description: One file, at most 20 MB: { url } (https) or { data (base64), filename, mime_type }.

person_refs.description: 1 to 50 person references from a profile or search result.

subject.description: The group's title; needs two or more people.

name: chat_start
title: Start a Conversation
